title: Usage of the Unified Data Repository Service for Policy Data; Stage 3
tagline: 29.519 — how PCF reads policy data from UDR
summary: TS 29.519 specifies how NFs — especially PCF — access policy data stored in UDR via Nudr_DataRepository. It complements 29.504 (the UDR service definition) with consumer-side URI patterns, data set names, and procedures for session management policy data reads during SmPolicyDecision.
defines: Policy data set naming and URI structure for UDR reads
Session management policy data model access
Relationship between 29.504 UDR API and PCF policy evaluation
whyItMatters: 29.512 references PCF reading policy data at step 5. TS 29.519 is the glue spec that explains exactly how that read is performed on UDR — the reason behind the PCF→UDR interaction in the establishment ladder.
